_about: Hard rules for every Jarvis agent (director, quality sub-director, copy and image workers). Built on 2026-11-02 from the live Shopify catalog (all 80 active products) and the existing BRAND_FACTS. Fields marked 'to_confirm' still need the owner's OK.

brand.name: Grozavu
brand.production: Made to order (print on demand via Printful)
brand.audience: men and women, plus a small kids line (Kids Organic Tee, Kids Cotton Cap)

emblem.primary: the Grozavu hare with the GROZAVU wordmark
approved_variants: hare inside a diamond (Heritage Diamond / Hare Argyle)
sequence of leaping hares from black through grey to white (Sculpted Hare)
embroidered hare and wordmark in white on black (beanies, bucket hat)
rules: The hare and the wordmark must never be redrawn, distorted, recoloured outside the product's real colourway, or replaced by an invented logo.
No other brand's logo, text or watermark may appear.

collections.Heritage: cocoa brown & bone and bordeaux & bone tartan, hare argyle, Christmas season
collections.Icons: core pieces carrying the hare: heavyweight hoodies, half-zips, wide-leg pants, Magenta Smoke, Two-Tone (black / soft pink), garment-dyed blush pink
collections.SS26: lighter summer pieces: boxy tees, long shorts, crossbody bags, snapback
collections.Street Culture: graffiti lettering, hare and wordmark, 'Urban Explorers'
collections.Lookbook: Shopify tag used on pieces featured in lookbook imagery
collections.Essentials: men essentials / women essentials: plain heavyweight basics

tone_of_voice.summary: Calm, precise and understated. Lead with the real fabric and cut; let details speak. No hype.
do: State the real fabric weight and composition from Shopify (e.g. '339 g/m² three-end fleece').
Describe how it wears: 'Sits close without clinging', 'stays quiet from a distance', 'the one you reach for'.
Short, concrete sentences. Men and women are addressed as 'men and women' or by the product's own cut.
dont: No exclamation-mark hype, no 'must-have', no fake urgency or countdowns.
Never generalise a fabric weight across products: quote the product's own data.

forbidden_claims: invented shipping times, return policies, reviews, ratings or sales figures
stock scarcity or reserved items (products are made to order)
discounts or codes that do not exist in Shopify
certifications a product does not carry in its Shopify description (GOTS, GRS, organic, recycled)

visual_quality_gate.product_fidelity: Compare with the product's real Shopify photos: same colourway name (cocoa is not bordeaux), same print placement, same cut and length, same hardware (silver zip, metal eyelets), correct hare.
visual_quality_gate.technical: No distorted hands, faces or text; no AI artefacts; sharp product; minimum 1080 px on the short side for social.
visual_quality_gate.people: No likeness of real, identifiable people. Never generate children with AI: kids products are shown as flat-lays or real photos only.
visual_quality_gate.disclosure: Label AI-generated or AI-altered imagery where the platform or EU law requires it.
visual_quality_gate.style_to_confirm: Photo style (studio vs street, black & white vs colour) is not verified yet: product images and the website could not be opened from the cloud session.
